primary_sources.citation: Herbster and Warmuth, Tracking the Best Expert, Machine Learning 1998
primary_sources.verified_point: Fixed Share comparison against a path with k expert switches uses the coding term ln J +(T-k-1)ln(1/(1-alpha)) + k[ln(1/alpha)+ln(J-1)], and alpha=k/(T-1) minimizes that term when T and k are fixed.

primary_sources.citation: de Rooij, van Erven, Grunwald, Koolen, Follow the Leader If You Can, Hedge If You Must, JMLR 2014
primary_sources.verified_point: Exponential-weights regret decomposes into a mix-loss/coding term plus cumulative mixability gap Delta; Hoeffding gives the conservative fixed-eta Delta upper bound eta*T/8 for losses in [0,1].

derivation_check: Fixed Share redistribution preserves total unnormalized exponential-weight mass. It is equivalent to an HMM/path prior with initial mass 1/J, stay probability 1-alpha and switch probability alpha/(J-1). Cumulative mix loss therefore telescopes to the negative log marginal likelihood divided by eta. Lower-bounding the marginal by any comparator path with k switches gives C/eta. Since actual mixture loss H equals mix loss M plus realized mixability gap Delta by definition, H-L_path <= C/eta+Delta follows for fixed eta.
scope_guards: The combined C/eta+Delta Fixed Share certificate is an independently checked synthesis of published ingredients, not a theorem quoted verbatim from either primary source.

The pathwise inequality is for realized bounded full-information loss. Mapping it to expected true proposal variance requires the worker's stated conditional-unbiasedness/convexity assumptions and a fixed or predictable comparator path; retrospective comparator selection from the same noisy loss stream needs additional uniform inference.

The 300- and 1000-replicate recurring-drift numerical tables were not independently replayed in this audit because the frozen certificate does not bind an executable simulator artifact plus complete RNG/runtime provenance sufficient to recreate the historical run exactly.
No conclusion about real-agent, scientific-workflow, or AGI performance follows from the synthetic validation.
